status: preferred for the experimental polygon-river build
notes: Gradients are m/m; 1.0 is 100% (45 degrees). The tanh cap softens the realised slope.
Bank distance drives depth; channel width is not used as a normalisation input.
Smoothing may fill deepest points; this is not an excavation-only smoother.
The algorithm lives in water_carver.river; Jamestown integration uses nz_terrain.river.polygon_build.
Lake, lagoon and seabed settings remain in water-configs/defaults.json and per-location overrides.
